beats.text: Women rated eighty percent of men as below average.
OkCupid analyzed how its users rated each other's looks.
Women were harsh. Eighty percent of men landed below medium.
Men rated women on a fair curve. Most women: right in the middle.
But men's messages? Two thirds went to the best-looking third of women.
So women judge harder. Men chase harder.

sources: OkCupid (2009), 'Your Looks and Your Inbox' (OkTrends). Women rated ~80% of men worse-looking than medium; men's ratings of women roughly symmetric around medium; two-thirds of male messages to the best-looking third of women.
